text_en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise child makes a glad father, but a foolish child is a mother’s grief.
text_cn: 智慧的儿子使父亲喜乐；愚昧的儿子，使母亲忧愁。

text_en: Treasures gained by wickedness do not profit, but righteousness delivers from death.
text_cn: 不义之财，毫无益处；惟有正义，救人脱免死亡。

text_en: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
text_cn: 上主不忍义人受饥，却使恶人大失所望。

text_en: A slack hand causes poverty, but the hand of the diligent makes rich.
text_cn: 游手好闲，使人贫穷；勤奋工作，使人富有。

text_en: A child who gathers in summer is prudent, but a child who sleeps in harvest brings shame.
text_cn: 夏季贮蓄的，是明智的孩童；秋收酣睡的是无耻的儿子。

text_en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
text_cn: 上主的祝福在义人头上，灾祸却使恶人哑口无言。

text_en: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
text_cn: 义人受人怀念祝福，恶人却必身败名裂。

text_en: The wise of heart will heed commandments, but a babbling fool will come to ruin.
text_cn: 心灵智慧的人，必接受命令；饶舌的愚妄人，必自招丧亡。

text_en: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever follows perverse ways will be found out.
text_cn: 走正路的，行路稳妥；走邪路的，终必败露。

text_en: Whoever winks the eye causes trouble, but the one who rebukes boldly makes peace.
text_cn: 暗中挤眼的人，必引人烦恼；坦然规劝的人，必促进和平。

text_en: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
text_cn: 义人的口，是生命的泉源；恶人的口，是残暴的渊薮(sǒu)。

text_en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all offenses.
text_cn: 仇恨引起争端，爱情遮掩一切过失。

text_en: On the lips of one who has understanding wisdom is found, but a rod is for the back of one who lacks sense.
text_cn: 有见识的口唇上，可找着智慧；棍杖只是为打缺乏智慧者的脊背。

text_en: The wise lay up knowledge, but the babbling of a fool brings ruin near.
text_cn: 智慧的人，隐讳自己学问；愚昧人的口，招致逼近的丧亡。

text_en: The wealth of the rich is their fortress; the poverty of the poor is their ruin.
text_cn: 富人的财富，是他自己的坚城；穷人的零落，却是他们的贫乏。

text_en: The wage of the righteous leads to life, the gain of the wicked to sin.
text_cn: 义人的薪金，用以维持生活；恶人的收入，却只用来犯罪。

text_en: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but one who rejects a rebuke goes astray.
text_cn: 谁遵守劝告，必走向生命之路；谁轻视规劝，必自误入迷途。

text_en: Lying lips conceal hatred, and whoever utters slander is a fool.
text_cn: 撒谎的唇舌，必暗藏仇恨；散播谣言的，必是愚昧人。

text_en: When words are many, transgression is not lacking, but the prudent are restrained in speech.
text_cn: 多言难免有过，明智的人必约束自己的唇舌。

text_en: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the mind of the wicked is of little worth.
text_cn: 义人的舌，贵若纯金；恶人的心，贱似草芥。

text_en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
text_cn: 义人的唇舌教育群众，愚人必因缺乏心智而死亡。

text_en: The blessing of the Lord makes rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.
text_cn: 使人致富的，是上主的祝福；营营的辛劳，却无补于事。

text_en: Doing wrong is like sport to a fool, but wise conduct is pleasure to a person of understanding.
text_cn: 愚昧人乐于作恶，明哲人乐于求智。

text_en: What the wicked dread will come upon them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
text_cn: 恶人畏惧的，反向他侵袭；义人的希望，终获得应允。

text_en: When the tempest passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are established forever.
text_cn: 暴风雨一过，恶人不复存在；义人却根深蒂固。

text_en: Like vinegar to the teeth, and smoke to the eyes, so are the lazy to their employers.
text_cn: 懒汉之于派遣他的人，就如醋之于牙，烟之于目。

text_en: The fear of the Lord prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be short.
text_cn: 敬畏上主，将延年益寿；恶人的岁月，必要短缩。

text_en: The hope of the righteous ends in gladness, but the expectation of the wicked comes to nothing.
text_cn: 义人的期待，终归是喜乐；恶人的希望，终归是失望。

text_en: The way of the Lord is a stronghold for the upright, but destruction for evildoers.
text_cn: 上主的道路，是正人君子的保障；为作恶的人，却是灭亡。

text_en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not remain in the land.
text_cn: 义人永不会动摇，恶人决不会久留地上。

text_en: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
text_cn: 义人的口，散播智慧；邪恶的舌，必被铲除。

text_en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.
text_cn: 义人的唇，常吐雅言，恶人的口，只说邪恶。
